invalid_client.title: Client Authentication Failed
invalid_client.description: The application is not registered or client authentication failed.

access_denied.title: Access Denied
access_denied.description: The user denied the authentication request.

unauthorized_client.title: Unauthorized Client
unauthorized_client.description: This client is not authorized to use the requested grant type.

unsupported_response_type.title: Unsupported Response Type
unsupported_response_type.description: The requested response type is not supported.

invalid_scope.title: Invalid Scope
invalid_scope.description: The requested scope is invalid or not allowed.

server_error.title: Server Error
server_error.description: An unexpected error occurred on the server.

temporarily_unavailable.title: Temporarily Unavailable
temporarily_unavailable.description: The server is temporarily unable to process the request. Please try again later.

invalid_token.title: Token Error
invalid_token.description: The token has expired or is invalid.

insufficient_scope.title: Insufficient Permissions
insufficient_scope.description: You don't have sufficient permissions for this operation.

request_not_supported.title: Request Not Supported
request_not_supported.description: The requested feature is not supported.

request_uri_not_supported.title: Request URI Not Supported
request_uri_not_supported.description: The request_uri parameter is not supported.

registration_not_supported.title: Registration Not Supported
registration_not_supported.description: Dynamic client registration is not supported.
